title: Deep learning on thyroid ultrasound keyframes predicts lymph node metastasis
summary: A fully automated deep learning model combined Mask R-CNN tumor segmentation with ResNet34 classification to predict cervical lymph node metastasis in 518 papillary thyroid carcinoma patients from two hospitals. Dice similarity was 0.88 in training and internal test and 0.85 in the external test; AUCs for metastasis prediction were 0.78, 0.83 and 0.83, above the radiomics model and, per the authors, radiologists. The study was retrospective.
ai_technology: Mask R-CNN segmentation and ResNet34 with a Bayes strategy on ultrasound video keyframes
organization: Tongji Hospital; Huazhong University of Science and Technology

evidence.tested: Training (n=340), internal test (n=83) and external hospital test (n=95).
evidence.unknown: Retrospective bicentral study; radiologist comparison details not fully in the abstract; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Deep learning automates tumor segmentation and metastasis prediction from ultrasound.
